abn.description: The Australian Business Number of the external legal entity that holds the registration; normalised by stripping spaces.

classification.description: The class/level awarded within that scheme (e.g. an R-level or a level name); the source aliases it from `classification` or `level`.

entity_name.description: The entity name as published in the source register.

expires_at.description: When the registration lapses; the parser reads `expires_at` or `valid_until` (`:145`).

last_synced_at.description: The instant the source register row was last normalised.

legal_entity_id.description: The fact subject anchor: the `org`-typed `Entity` row the registration is anchored to. Declared as the `LEGAL_ENTITY` context coordinate at `OPTIONAL`.

registered_at.description: When the registration took effect on the scheme; the parser reads `registered_at` or `valid_from` (`:144`) and the projector uses it as `occurred_at` (`:183`).

scheme.description: The prequalification scheme the registration is held on. Code set today: `tfnsw_r_levels`, `nsw_construction`, `vic_csr`, `qld_tmr`, `federal_npp`.

status.description: Registration status as published. Defaults to `"active"` in the parser (`:143`); the projector only ever projects `active` rows (`:105-108`), so in this shelf it is effectively constant.
